title: UDP Write
text: Send UDP packets to remote host, 1 input, 1 output; {Remote IP address (255.255.255.255 for broadcast)} sets the iP address of remote host to which data is sent, {Remote port} sets the iP port of remote host to which data, {Local port} sets the iP port number of application on target from which data and {Byte order}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: msg
ports.summary: UDP packet sent to remote host numeric vector

params.name: Remote IP address (255.255.255.255 for broadcast)
params.values: IP address of remote host to which data is sent 127.0.0.1 (default) | dotted-quad expression

params.name: Remote port
params.values: IP port of remote host to which data is sent 25000 (default) | integer from 1 to 65,535

params.name: Local port
params.values: IP port number of application on target from which data is sent -1 (default) | integer from 1 to 65,535
